description:
Updates configuration for an existing monitor (name, target URL, interval, HTTP method, headers, expected status code).

Use this tool when a user wants to edit or reconfigure a monitor.

body.description: Request payload body for POST/PUT checks.

id.description: The unique ID of the monitor to update.

keyword.description: Keyword string expected in response body.

name.description: New descriptive name for the monitor.

target.description: New target URL or IP address.

name: update_monitor
